encoded_feature_collision.interpretation_limit: The accepted NPZ retains encoded candidate vectors, while run JSON retains projection digests and legal-action identities but not raw per-candidate projection payloads. Exact encoded-vector aliases are observable; source-token collision pairs cannot be reconstructed for every historical row.

semantic_hash_audit.consequence: Because dimension 2048 uses the low 11 bits of the little-endian integer for the bucket, digest byte 0 bit 0 is also the bucket parity bit. Every even bucket is forced negative and every odd bucket forced positive; sign is not independent of bucket as intended by ordinary signed feature hashing.
